description: Measure sound levels with your microphone — live dB readout with peak hold.

faqs.a: It measures RMS energy from your microphone and converts it to a relative dB value.
faqs.q: How is the dB value computed?

faqs.a: No — every microphone is different and browsers don't know the calibration. Use it to compare relative loudness, not for absolute measurements.
A large live meter, a numeric readout, and a peak-hold marker that resets automatically.

howto: Press Start and allow microphone access.
title: Decibel Meter
